root.description: Stop searching for .editorconfig files in parent directories

end_of_line.description: Line ending style (lf, cr, or crlf)

charset.description: Character encoding (utf-8, latin1, utf-8-bom, utf-16be, utf-16le)

trim_trailing_whitespace.description: Remove trailing whitespace at end of lines

insert_final_newline.description: Ensure files end with a newline

sections.description: List of section definitions with patterns and properties to override defaults for specific file sets. Each item specifies a file path pattern and optional EditorConfig properties to apply to matching files. All properties are optional per section, matching the supported EditorConfig specification. Use 'indent_style', 'indent_size', etc. to define overrides for indentation, line endings, charset, etc. for the given pattern. Use 'unset' to remove a previously defined property (e.g., indent_size = unset). See spec for supported wildcards: *, **, ?, [name], [!name], {a,b}, {n1..n2}. Patterns are case-sensitive and use forward slashes only as path separators. Comments should go on their own lines and start with # or ;. Example: pattern = '*.py', indent_style = 'space', indent_size = 4, description = 'Python files'.
